title: Scaling up the DSMES Learning Collaborative
official: INSPIRED: Implementation of Novel Strategies to Promote Improvements in Referrals and Engagement for DSMES
summary: A multicomponent implementation strategy bundle designed to improve Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) referral and utilization in rural primary care clinics. The initial bundle includes: (1) establishing electronic health record (EHR) referral systems, (2) creating patient face sheets for providers, (3) discussing DSMES referrals during clinician and staff implementation team meetings, and (4) developing DSMES-specific marketing materials and promotional activities.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Members of implementation teams at participating rural primary care clinics, including physicians, nurses, hospital administrators, IT staff, and practice managers.

Exclusion Criteria:

* n/a
